newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq lifted by strong corporate earnings.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq lifted by strong corporate earnings.

text.p: Strong corporate earnings pushed Nasdaq shares higher Thursday, despite inflation fears that spooked the market at midday.

The Nasdaq composite gained 6.94 points or 0.52 percent to close unofficially at 1340.47. The Dow Industrials Average edged 38.49 points higher to close unofficially at 6765.37, a new record. In late trading, the long bond lost 16/32 to 6.83 percent.
Comments on inflation by a Federal Reserve governor rattled some investors at mid-day, but solid corporate earnings lead the market on a high-volume day, traders said.
Sun Microsystems Inc, which posted strong second quarter earnings late on Wednesday, lifted Nasdaq shares higher. Sun Microsystems gained 2-13/16 to 31-1/1.
"Some tech stocks perked up. There was some recovery after selling yesterday in Intel," one trader said.
Intel Corp gained 3/8 to 142-3/8. Microsoft Corp increased 1-3/8 to 86. Xilinx Inc, which also reported earnings after Wednesday's close, jumped 5-1/8 to 42-3/4.
Gainers beat losers 2208 to 2112 on total volume of 729 million.
